verified_failures.evidence: formal_development_evaluation.main validates a bindings JSON and then unconditionally raises FormalEvaluationError; it cannot execute the verified 36-partition adapter or produce a complete formal artifact.

A focused synthetic delay=1 path deterministically raises MeanReversionV2Error: missing exact ordinary fill; forward scan prohibited. The evaluator applies a target due at the current base fill using the current identity's later delayed timestamp/prices.
Standalone paths reuse Clock.actual values 0.0/0.5 without scaling the named asset to the frozen standalone zero-or-one target; the required asset sensitivity is not evaluated.
BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT buy-and-hold comparators are instantiated at 50% risky exposure and 50% cash rather than the named single-asset buy-and-hold exposure.

The comparator passes the same target weights at every synchronized fill to self_financing, mechanically rebalancing and charging turnover instead of buying once, drifting without rebalance, and liquidating terminally.
The seven current registry values are sum(path.returns)/len(path.returns), not the frozen nonannualized daily Sharpes on the seven-trial common panel.

Regime eligibility checks only return-vector length >=45 and does not require at least five completed entries per regime; it also sums returns rather than computing the frozen compounded regime net result.

The evaluator assigns exactly one half of every portfolio return to each asset instead of using aggregate and standalone daily net currency PnL; the exceptional-trade evidence is not the frozen quantity.
Formal fold paths filter already-derived full-boundary sessions and fills instead of constructing each fold from its own boundary-specific row index as required by the strict-prefix contract.
input_identity_pass and strict_prefix_pass are supplied as literal true values; the frozen contract requires these claims to be derived from validated evidence.

deterministic_validation.interpretation: Passing tests and tooling do not establish contract fidelity or profitability; parent source inspection and focused diagnostics exposed uncovered defects.

round_effect: The round added a useful in-memory skeleton but did not create a valid production execution path and did not remove the blocker to one clean economic result.
